faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Flyer Distribution

items.question: What is flyer distribution and which areas do you cover?
items.answer: Flyer distribution is the professional door-to-door delivery of flyers, catalogues and promotional material to homes and businesses. We cover Arta and the wider Epirus region.

items.question: How many flyers can you distribute?
items.answer: We handle campaigns from 500 to 50,000+ printed pieces. Every distribution campaign is planned strategically for maximum reach within your target audience.

items.question: How long does distribution take?
items.answer: A typical flyer distribution campaign in Arta is completed within 1-5 working days. We provide a completion report once distribution is finished.

items.question: Do you offer targeted distribution in specific areas?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fully targeted distribution based on geographic area, demographics or business type. We analyse your target audience and design the optimal route.

items.question: What materials do you handle?
items.answer: We distribute flyers, catalogues, restaurant menus, newsletters and promotional leaflets — any printed advertising material you need.
